skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 2 consecutive strikes to a single target for 120% ATK, with a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] (deals 100% of Suiryu's ATK when the target attacks, then disappears once triggered).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks an entire row of enemies with 5 consecutive strikes for 400% ATK.Triggers [Breakthrough] (cancels [Specialized Unyielding], once per attack).Has a 75% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the main target and 3 random enemies (deals 600% of Suiryu's ATK when the target attacks, then disappears once triggered).Grants himself [Specialized Guard] equal to 400% ATK.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Ultimate DMG 400% → 600%[Internal Injury] chance 75% → 90%[Internal Injury] DMG 600% → 750%Self [Specialized Guard] 400% → 600%

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently grants himself 50% Injury Boost.Grants himself 50% Non-Crit DMG Free, lasting 4 turns.After taking Fatal DMG, recovers 50% max HP, once per battle.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Injury Boost 65% → 80%Self Non-Crit DMG Free 50% → 60%Healing after Fatal DMG 50% → 80%

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After casting Ultimate, launches [Continuous Follow-Up] to 2 random enemies with [Internal Injury] (100% of Ultimate DMG and effect, if less than 2 enemies, can Follow-up on the same target). Immune to [Adhesion/Paralyzed]

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Continuous Follow-up to 2 enemies > 3 enemies Follow-up if less than 2 enemies > 3 enemies Additional: After recovering from [Specialized Unyielding], launches [Continuous Follow-up] to 2 random enemies (80% of Ultimate DMG and 100% of Ultimate effect, if less than 2 enemies, can Follow-up on the same target).

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
PvP-tier shields absorb incoming damage, granted at a value based on Attack (e.g. 400% ATK).
Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
Removes the target's Resilience shield and increases the attack for that attack.
